newsitem.title: USA: Bally Total issues 7 mln shrs at $12/shr.
newsitem.headline: Bally Total issues 7 mln shrs at $12/shr.

text.p: Bally Total Fitness Holding Corp said it issued seven million shares of common stock at $12 per share, through underwriters led by Merrill Lynch & Co.
"Excluding the underwriters' over-allotment of one million shares, the company will receive approximately $79 million of net proceeds from the $84 million offering," Bally Total said.
Bally Total is the largest U.S. commercial fitness center company, with about four million members and 320 facilities in 27 states and Canada.
The stock issue was a secondary offering, said the company.
